verses.en: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
verses.pt: Passados estes negócios, aconteceu que Nabote de Jezreel tinha em Jezreel uma vinha junto ao palácio de Acabe rei de Samaria.
verses.en_web: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
verses.en_bbe: Now Naboth the Jezreelite had a vine-garden in Jezreel, near the house of Ahab, king of Samaria.

verses.en: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.
verses.pt: E Acabe falou a Nabote, dizendo: Dá-me tua vinha para uma horta de legumes, porque está próxima, junto a minha casa, e eu te darei por ela outra vinha melhor que esta; ou se melhor te parecer, te pagarei seu valor em dinheiro.
verses.en_web: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”
verses.en_bbe: And Ahab said to Naboth, Give me your vine-garden so that I may have it for a garden of sweet plants, for it is near my house; and let me give you a better vine-garden in exchange, or, if it seems good to you, let me give you its value in money.

verses.en: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
verses.pt: E Nabote respondeu a Acabe: Guarde-me o SENHOR de que eu te dê a ti a propriedade de meus pais.
verses.en_web: Naboth said to Ahab, “May Yahweh forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”
verses.en_bbe: But Naboth said to Ahab, By the Lord, far be it from me to give you the heritage of my fathers.

verses.en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
verses.pt: E veio Acabe à sua casa triste e irritado, pela palavra que Nabote de Jezreel havia lhe respondido, dizendo: Não te darei a propriedade de meus pais. E deitou-se em sua cama, e virou seu rosto, e não comeu pão.
verses.en_web: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him; for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
verses.en_bbe: So Ahab came into his house bitter and angry because Naboth the Jezreelite had said to him, I will not give you the heritage of my fathers. And stretching himself on the bed with his face turned away, he would take no food.

verses.en: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?
verses.pt: E veio a ele sua mulher Jezabel, e disse-lhe: Por que está tão triste teu espírito, e não comes pão?
verses.en_web: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad, that you eat no bread?”
verses.en_bbe: But Jezebel, his wife, came to him and said, Why is your spirit so bitter that you have no desire for food?

verses.en: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.
verses.pt: E ele respondeu: Porque falei com Nabote de Jezreel, e disse-lhe que me desse sua vinha por dinheiro, ou que, se mais quisesse, eu lhe daria outra vinha por ela; e ele respondeu: Eu não te darei minha vinha.
verses.en_web: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to her, Because I was talking to Naboth the Jezreelite, and I said to him, Let me have your vine-garden for a price, or, if it is pleasing to you, I will give you another vine-garden for it: and he said, I will not give you my vine-garden.

verses.en: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.pt: E sua mulher Jezabel lhe disse: És tu agora rei sobre Israel? Levanta-te, e come pão, e alegra-te: eu te darei a vinha de Nabote de Jezreel.
verses.en_web: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Jezebel, his wife, said, Are you now the ruler of Israel? Get up, take food, and let your heart be glad; I will give you the vine-garden of Naboth the Jezreelite.

verses.en: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.
verses.pt: Então ela escreveu cartas em nome de Acabe, e selou-as com seu anel e enviou-as aos anciãos e aos principais que moravam em sua cidade com Nabote.
verses.en_web: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.
verses.en_bbe: So she sent a letter in Ahab's name, stamped with his stamp, to the responsible men and the chiefs who were in authority with Naboth.

verses.en: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:
verses.pt: E as cartas que escreveu diziam assim: Proclamai jejum, e ponde a Nabote em posição de destaque do povo;
verses.en_web: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
verses.en_bbe: And in the letter she said, Let a time of public sorrow be fixed, and put Naboth at the head of the people;

verses.en: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.
verses.pt: E ponde dois homens perversos diante dele, que testemunhem contra ele, e digam: Tu blasfemaste a Deus e ao rei. E então o tirai, e apedrejai-o, e morra.
verses.en_web: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”
verses.en_bbe: And get two good-for-nothing persons to come before him and give witness that he has been cursing God and the king. Then take him out and have him stoned to death.

verses.en: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
verses.pt: E os de sua cidade, os anciãos e os principais que moravam em sua cidade, o fizeram como Jezabel lhes mandou, conforme o escrito nas cartas que ela lhes havia enviado.
verses.en_web: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.
verses.en_bbe: So the responsible men and the chiefs who were in authority in his town, did as Jezebel had said in the letter she sent them.

verses.en: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
verses.pt: E promulgaram jejum, e assentaram a Nabote em posição de destaque do povo.
verses.en_web: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
verses.en_bbe: They gave orders for a day of public sorrow, and put Naboth at the head of the people.

verses.en: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.
verses.pt: Vieram então dois homens perversos, e sentaram-se diante dele: e aqueles homens de Belial testemunharam contra Nabote diante do povo, dizendo: Nabote blasfemou a Deus e ao rei. E tiraram-no fora da cidade, e apedrejaram-no com pedras, e morreu.
verses.en_web: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.
verses.en_bbe: And the two good-for-nothing persons came in and took their seats before him and gave witness against Naboth, in front of the people, saying, Naboth has been cursing God and the king. Then they took him outside the town and had him stoned to death.

verses.en: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
verses.pt: Depois enviaram a dizer a Jezabel: Nabote foi apedrejado e morto.
verses.en_web: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned, and is dead.”
verses.en_bbe: And they sent word to Jezebel, saying, Naboth has been stoned and is dead.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
verses.pt: E quando Jezabel ouviu que Nabote havia sido apedrejado e morto, disse a Acabe: Levanta-te e possui a vinha de Nabote de Jezreel, que não te a quis dar por dinheiro; porque Nabote não vive, mas sim que está morto.
verses.en_web: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned, and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Jezebel, hearing that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, said to Ahab, Get up and take as your heritage the vine-garden of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he would not give you for money, for Naboth is no longer living but is dead.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
verses.pt: E ouvindo Acabe que Nabote era morto, levantou-se para descer à vinha de Nabote de Jezreel, para tomar possessão dela.
verses.en_web: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
verses.en_bbe: So Ahab, hearing that Naboth was dead, went down to the vine-garden of Naboth the Jezreelite to take it as his heritage.

verses.en: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.pt: Então veio a palavra do SENHOR a Elias Tisbita, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.en: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
verses.pt: Levanta-te, desce a encontrar-te com Acabe rei de Israel, que está em Samaria: eis que ele está na vinha de Nabote, à qual desceu para tomar possessão dela.
verses.en_web: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.
verses.en_bbe: Go down to Ahab, king of Israel, in Samaria; see, he is in the vine-garden of Naboth the Jezreelite, where he has gone to take it as his heritage.

verses.en: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.
verses.pt: E falar-lhe hás, dizendo: Assim disse o SENHOR: Não mataste e também possuíste? E voltarás a falar-lhe, dizendo: Assim disse o SENHOR: No mesmo lugar de onde lamberam os cães o sangue de Nabote, os cães lamberão também teu sangue, o teu mesmo.
verses.en_web: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”
verses.en_bbe: Say to him, The Lord says, Have you put a man to death and taken his heritage? Then say to him, The Lord says, In the place where dogs have been drinking the blood of Naboth, there will your blood become the drink of dogs.

verses.en: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.
verses.pt: E Acabe disse a Elias: Achaste-me, inimigo meu? E ele respondeu: Eu te encontrei, porque te vendeste a fazer o mal diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight.
verses.en_bbe: And Ahab said to Elijah, Have you come face to face with me, O my hater? And he said, I have come to you because you have given yourself up to do evil in the eyes of the Lord.

verses.en: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,
verses.pt: Eis que eu trago mal sobre ti, e varrerei tua posteridade, e exterminarei de Acabe todo macho, ao escravo e ao livre em Israel:
verses.en_web: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.
verses.en_bbe: See, I will send evil on you and put an end to you completely, cutting off from Ahab every male child, him who is shut up and him who goes free in Israel;

verses.en: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.
verses.pt: E eu porei tua casa como a casa de Jeroboão filho de Nebate, e como a casa de Baasa filho de Aías; pela provocação com que me provocaste à ira, e com que fizeste pecar a Israel.
verses.en_web: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will make your family like the family of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, and like the family of Baasha, the son of Ahijah, because you have made me angry, and have made Israel do evil.

verses.en: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
verses.pt: De Jezabel também falou o SENHOR, dizendo: Os cães comerão a Jezabel no muro de Jezreel.
verses.en_web: Yahweh also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.
verses.en_bbe: And of Jezebel the Lord said, Jezebel will become food for dogs in the heritage of Jezreel.

verses.en: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.pt: O que de Acabe for morto na cidade, cães lhe comerão: e o que for morto no campo, comê-lo-ão as aves do céu.
verses.en_web: The dogs will eat he who dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat he who dies in the field.”
verses.en_bbe: Any man of the family of Ahab who comes to his death in the town will become food for the dogs; and he who comes to his death in the open country will be food for the birds of the air.

verses.en: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
verses.pt: (À verdade ninguém foi como Acabe, que se vendeu a fazer o mal aos olhos do SENHOR; porque Jezabel sua mulher o incitava.
verses.en_web: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
verses.en_bbe: (There was no one like Ahab, who gave himself up to do evil in the eyes of the Lord, moved to it by Jezebel his wife.

verses.en: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Ele foi em grande maneira abominável, caminhando após o os ídolos, conforme a tudo o que fizeram os amorreus, aos quais lançou o SENHOR diante dos filhos de Israel.)
verses.en_web: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: He did a very disgusting thing in going after false gods, doing all the things the Amorites did, whom the Lord sent out before the children of Israel.)

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
verses.pt: E aconteceu quando Acabe ouviu estas palavras, que rasgou suas roupas, e pôs saco sobre sua carne, e jejuou, e dormiu em saco, e andou humilhado.
verses.en_web: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
verses.en_bbe: Hearing these words, Ahab, in great grief, put haircloth on his flesh and went without food, sleeping in haircloth, and going about quietly.

verses.en: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.pt: Então veio a palavra do SENHOR a Elias Tisbita, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.en: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.
verses.pt: Não viste como Acabe se humilhou diante de mim? Pois porquanto se humilhou diante de mim, não trarei o mal em seus dias: nos dias de seu filho trarei o mal sobre sua casa.
verses.en_web: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”
verses.en_bbe: Do you see how Ahab has made himself low before me? because he has made himself low before me, I will not send the evil in his life-time, but in his son's time I will send the evil on his family.
